responsibility: Implements the core `Gogo` compilation-unit representation and related foundational utilities for the Go frontend. It constructs predeclared types, constants, and builtins; manages packages, globals, imports, init tracking, traversal helpers, and statement insertion; and serves as the owning hub through which parsing, type processing, lowering, export/import, runtime integration, and later transformation passes coordinate package-wide state.
same_name_distinction: Defines the out-of-line behavior for the `Gogo` and closely related helper classes declared in `gogo.h`, including construction of predeclared objects, package/import state management, traversal support, and statement insertion mechanics. Unlike `gogo.h`, it is the implementation unit rather than the shared declaration surface for that central IR container API.
